title: Friday Night at Muziekgieterij
description: Late-night DJ sets and live electronic acts in the old Sphinx factory hall. Doors 22:00, last round 04:00.

title: MVV Maastricht vs Helmond Sport
description: Keuken Kampioen Divisie home fixture. Gates open 18:30. Student tickets at the Geusselt kiosk.

title: Sunday Brunch on Onze Lieve Vrouweplein
description: Terrace brunch with Limburg vlaai, eggs, and filter coffee facing the basilica. Reservations recommended after 11:30.

title: Bonnefanten: Late Opening & Talk
description: Free Thursday late opening with a 19:00 curator talk on the contemporary collection. Museum café stays open until 21:00.

title: Introborrel MSV Tragos
description: Open intro drinks for UM students. Bring your student card. Speeches at 20:30, then bar and board games upstairs.

title: Vrijthof Open-Air Saturday
description: Outdoor pop and dance night on the square between St. Servaas and St. Jan. Wristbands at the Markt side.

title: Tapijn Park Football Meetup
description: Casual five-a-side on the Tapijn fields. Bring a white or dark shirt. Kick-off 10:00, extra bibs at the pavilion.

title: Wyck Food Walk: Rechtstraat Bites
description: Three-stop tasting walk through Wyck: natural wine, bitterballen, and a main at a Rechtstraat bistro. Meet at the railway-side end.

title: Theater aan het Vrijthof: Chamber Concert
description: Philharmonie Zuidnederland chamber programme in the small hall. Doors 19:30. Interval drinks in the foyer overlooking the square.

title: Koko Gamer: Society Quiz Night
description: Student-society quiz in teams of four. Themes: UM campus lore, Limburg, and pop culture. Entry includes one drink.
